docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Young Jim Hawkins finds a treasure map in a dead pirate's chest and sails with Long John Silver to an island of buried gold.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Robert Louis Stevenson (1850–1894), Treasure Island, 1883. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
